blocks.html: Being a neighborhood grocery store is about more than just selling groceries. It’s also about being good neighbors, every day, in every Trader Joe’s neighborhood. Through our Neighborhood Shares Program, we are able to provide nourishment to our neighbors, every day, in every store, by proudly donating 100% of products that go unsold but remain fit to be enjoyed to local non-profit organizations. Nearly 80% of products donated through the Neighborhood Shares Program are items such as produce, entrees (salads, sandwiches, soups, etc.), bakery, proteins, dairy, and eggs.

Every Trader Joe’s store manages its own Neighborhood Shares Program, partnering with non-profit organizations that do important work in our neighborhoods across the country. We are committed to being good neighbors, and work with a variety of community-based non-profit partners that share our goals of nourishing our neighbors in meaningful and intentional ways.

We regularly hear from our partners just how impactful the food and products they receive from Trader Joe’s helps to sustain and transform the communities they serve. Here are just a few examples of feedback we’ve received from these partners in 2025:

Trader Joe’s, we are grateful for you—we would like to extend a heartfelt thanks for your valued partnership. Through your generosity and support, you’ve helped us meet urgent needs and build lasting solutions for the communities we serve. Thank you for being a beacon of light to children and families across the nation and an essential part of our journey together.

~ Feed the Children

Thank you for all your support over the past year here in the South Florida area! Your stores, Captains and Mates are so giving and compassionate and among our favorite people. Please share our appreciation! 

~ Food Rescue US South, Florida

As the year comes to a close, we want to sincerely thank Trader Joe’s for your commitment to reducing food waste while helping nourish our community. Your willingness to donate fresh/frozen excess perishable food makes an immediate and meaningful difference for the many hinger agencies serving our neighbors. 

~ Food Rescue US Lansing, MI

Thank you, Trader Joe’s for your partnership, and support this year. We are so grateful for your trust in Food Connect to support your new stores this year! All four stores we support are just an absolute delight to work with, and the recipient organizations are endlessly grateful for these healthy & nutritious food donations they receive from their local store’s Neighborhood Program. 

~ Food Connect Group Chester County, PA

We just want to take a moment to say thank you for the beautiful flowers you consistently donate to us. It truly brightens our residents' days and brings so much joy to our team. We appreciate you deeply for thinking of our seniors all the time. 

~ Jamboree Housing Orange County, CA

In total, Trader Joe’s supports more than 2,100 Neighborhood Shares partners nationwide. We are grateful to these partners as they strive to minimize hunger, serving millions of people in and around the neighborhoods where we have stores.
